editorial:
Imagine being a top-tier pilot who gets shot down in enemy territory and wakes up as a prisoner of war. That is exactly what happens to Major Ronan Jackson. S. Senator, which makes his situation a total nightmare for the government. You get to follow two different stories at once: Jackson trying to survive his captors and a tough squad of elite soldiers led by Dave Torres who are fighting their way through dangerous lands to get him back. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel the pressure of a ticking clock as the rescue team races against time.

What really works here is the action and the bond between the soldiers. The pacing keeps you on your toes, though some of the dialogue feels a bit stiff at times. If you love movies about special ops and daring rescues, you will enjoy this one.
endingExplained: In the final act, the rescue team manages to track Jackson down to a hidden compound. After a big, loud shootout with the Hezbollah fighters, Dave Torres and his crew break Jackson out just in time. They fight through a final wave of enemies to reach the extraction point. The movie wraps up with the soldiers successfully getting Jackson home, proving that loyalty and bravery can win even in the toughest wars.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves military rescue missions and high-stakes action.
